【原视频简介】
Here's an easy way to grow beautiful crystals from ordinary fertilizer.

I don't think I remember seeing a detailed tutorial video, so I made this one to show you how I do it.

For a very detailed written guide on making this work, check out my son's blog post at https://crystalverse.com/growing-crystals

---

MATERIALS

I bought my materials in Malaysia, but the items below are similar ones available on Amazon — they work just as well if you’d like to try this experiment yourself.

• Monoammonium phosphate fertilizer: https://amzn.to/49fcy0Q
• Alum stone: https://amzn.to/47WEog4
• 250 mL beaker: https://amzn.to/49P4mob
• 500 mL beaker: https://amzn.to/49OegX7
• 125 mm crystallizing dish: https://amzn.to/3WQZUO5
• Electric burner: https://amzn.to/47MeHi8
• Ice pick: https://amzn.to/3XmbGAb
• Precision tweezers: https://amzn.to/47AS0yB
• Plastic petri dish (90 × 15 mm): https://amzn.to/4r05jjS
• Digital scale: https://amzn.to/4olYTsy

These are Amazon affiliate links — I may earn a small commission if you purchase through them, at no extra cost to you.

Thank you for supporting this channel!
